howto.what: 让它按 `esm` Python SDK 的写法帮你做蛋白质工作:用 ESM3 生成或补全序列、预测结构,用 ESMC 计算嵌入向量,并连 Forge/Biohub 推理客户端跑生成任务。
howto.when: 当你直接使用 `esm` Python SDK、ESM3 或 ESMC 模型 ID、Forge/Biohub 推理客户端等场景时接管。

say.text: 用 esm3-open 补全这段带 '_' 掩码的蛋白序列

say.text: 用 ESMC 给这几条蛋白序列算嵌入向量
say.note: 返回用于下游任务的 embeddings

howto.what_en: It makes Claude work through the `esm` Python SDK: generate or complete protein sequences and predict structures with ESM3, compute embeddings with ESMC, and call Forge/Biohub inference clients.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you work directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Complete this protein sequence with masked '_' positions using esm3-open
say_en.note: Runs local open weights to generate a sequence

say_en.text: Compute embeddings for these protein sequences with ESMC
Async batch-generate 10 protein sequences with the Forge client
say_en.note: Reads ESM_API_KEY then runs concurrent calls
